name: Kami-Shakujii
tagline: Shinjuku in 34 minutes and Shibuya in 43 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, served by Seibu Shinjuku Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 43 minutes to Otemachi, 34 minutes to Shinjuku, 43 minutes to Shibuya and 64 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 50.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 50.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 49.7 m to 52.3 m, a difference of 2.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 4 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 医療法人社団 杏順会 越川病院, about 1034 m away and 千秋会田中脳神経外科病院, about 1050 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Shinjuku Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
